summary: Iter34 — verified 4 fixes. 11/12 pytest cases PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_iter34.py (1 skipped only because the rate-limit test earlier in the same run exhausted /auth/google/start quota, so the sibling glogin-state mint for the Drive-callback test was skipped; the garbage-state variant covering the exact same code branch passed). (1) chat._save_ai_msg source confirmed: `if via != 'realtime' and not (extra or {}).get('tool'): await _fanout_message(...)` — assistant 'task done' / tool / search messages do NOT trigger message_new; regular assistant replies DO (verified behaviorally: sent 'Halo singkat tes 34' via POST /api/conversations/{cid}/send and the connected /api/ws/user received {'type':'message_new','conversation_id':<cid>,'sender_name':'Rio','preview':'Halo, tes 34 masuk jelas.'}). assignments.py task_done call confirmed to pass {'tool':'task_done',...}. (2) POST /api/auth/google/start returns 200 with authorization_url (state in query) AND Set-Cookie oryntix_gl (path=/api/auth/google, httpOnly). Exchange without the cookie → 400 'Sesi login Google tidak valid…'. Exchange with the cookie but a fake code → 400 'Kode Google tidak valid…' (proves state+cookie CSRF check passed, Google rejects the fake code). Exchange with a tampered state → 400 'Sesi login Google tidak valid…'. Hammered /start → 429 'Terlalu banyak percobaan' triggered within ~15 attempts. (3) GET /api/integrations/google/callback with code=x & state=<glogin-state from /auth/google/start> OR state='garbage' → 307 Location: /integrations?error=state (never 500). (4) wss://.../api/ws/user?token=bad → connection closed with 4401 (or handshake 401/403); with a valid demo JWT the WS stays open and a reminder created via POST /api/reminders (start_at=now+55s) triggers a {'type':'reminder_due',...} JSON event delivered on the WS within the scheduler tick. (Frontend quick check): /auth/google?error=access_denied renders data-testid='google-callback-error' with exact text 'Anda membatalkan login Google.'; /login renders data-testid='auth-google-btn'.
critical_code_review_comments: google_auth.py: cookie flag `secure=x.redirect_uri.startswith('https')` is good; path='/api/auth/google' correctly scopes it. Nonce stored both in signed state + cookie — correct CSRF/double-submit pattern.

chat.py _save_ai_msg guard `not (extra or {}).get('tool')` is correct and testable from source; combined with via!='realtime' it avoids extra push on tool/system messages while still fanning out normal assistant replies.

integrations.py google_callback: `claims.get('purpose') != 'gdrive' or not claims.get('sub')` returns 307 to /integrations?error=state for glogin-state (purpose='glogin', no 'sub'), tampered or missing state — never 500.

server.py ws_user: when token invalid, `await ws.close(code=4401)` is called before accept. Starlette translates pre-accept close into 403 handshake rejection (also acceptable per the review request). The frontend userEvents.js correctly stops reconnecting on ev.code === 4401.

success_rate.backend: 100% (11/11 executed; 1 skipped due to shared rate-limit, covered by sibling test)
